question: Should this PR's managed delivery-queue media store be accepted as the upgrade path for Codex generated-image handoff once rebased, or should the fix be narrowed to Codex projector media persistence only?
rationale: The diff now crosses Codex, gateway, outbound delivery, media storage, and Telegram result details, and the live branch is conflicting, so green focused tests and Slack proof do not by themselves settle the merge/upgrade boundary.

options.title: Rebase and accept managed queue media
options.body: Resolve the conflict, keep the full managed-media handoff, and rerun focused Codex plus outbound queue recovery tests before merge.

options.title: Narrow to Codex projector persistence
options.body: Limit this PR to typed-result persistence and defer delivery-queue media ownership to a separate owner-reviewed PR.

options.title: Replace the branch
options.body: If conflict resolution changes too much of the queue semantics, close this branch in favor of a fresh narrow PR with the same proof target.

recommendation.title: Rebase and accept managed queue media
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict, keep the full managed-media handoff, and rerun focused Codex plus outbound queue recovery tests before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR crosses the Codex app-server harness and outbound media seams that Peter introduced or recently owned in adjacent history.
